title: 建築情報デザイン
subtitle: Architectural Information Design
teachers:
HIROSE Hiroki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course is a higher class of "Architectural CAD" and learns more advanced techniques of creating and managing building 3D model.
Specifically, through learning basic visual programming on CAD, students understand rational, precise, and flexible method of defining and editing the shape of a building (or a part of it) based on rules.
Students should also consider the application and significance of various 3D model creation techniques in a series of processes from design to construction.
advice:
In this course, the lesson will be conducted as the following process.

1st week; Orientation
2nd-4th week; Creation and editing of architectural 3D form using CAD + Visual Programming
5th-7th week; Creating and arranging members using CAD + Visual Programming
8th week; Submission of Assignment 1
9th-12th week; Various techniques of CAD + Visual Programming
13th week; Submission of Assignment 2
14th week; further developing examples of CAD + Visual Programming
15th week; self-check
books: Tutorial movies will be prepared during a course period.
requiredKnowledge: Classes will be conducted assuming that students had some experience using 3D CAD software in fields of architecture.

activityGoals.body: Students can understand the significance and accuracy of 3D data at each stage of building construction process.
Students can understand structural features and ideas from the related documents about buildings.
Students can consider visual programming specifications based on the constitution of the building shape.
Students can efficiently create and edit 3D models using visual programming.
Students can think about the role and potential of visual programming in CAD software.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can envision a characteristic space unique to visual programming and create highly advanced VP tools for creating the shape. They can also propose optimized design through evaluating various alternative designs generated by the tool.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can envision a characteristic space unique to visual programming and create usable VP tools for creating the shape. They can also propose better design through evaluating some alternative designs generated by the tool.

              This course is a higher class of "Architectural CAD" and learns more advanced techniques of creating and managing building 3D model.
Specifically, through learning basic visual programming on CAD, students understand rational, precise, and flexible method of defining and editing the shape of a building (or a part of it) based on rules.
Students should also consider the application and significance of various 3D model creation techniques in a series of processes from design to construction.
